svg.aria-label: Video frame order, temporal mean and local filtering
svg.title: Video frame order, temporal mean and local filtering
svg.desc: The same selected frames can be reordered without changing their mean image, while local temporal responses can change.

g.text: sample stride = 1 | selected frames = 8 | original indices below
g[i] = (p[i+1] - p[i-1]) / 2. This is a toy feature response, not optical flow.
